title: Repair an integrated failure in a newly assigned worker slot

rubric.text: Keeps the original WIRE owner and proposes assigning it the free suitable slot, requiring the exact checkout path once assigned and a base handoff from failed integrated head 2222222 on a fresh unique repair branch; does not invent an unavailable path
Preserves integrated head 2222222 and the original task branch references, pauses dependents and further integration, and leaves the slot occupied by another owner untouched
Requires task-scoped repair acceptance by independent inspection and reruns the affected checks after integrating the repair before continuing
Retires the verified surplus completed run-owned checkout when cleanup can proceed, retains the still-active unfinished checkout, and reports each disposition with its reason
